summary: Harmony Gold Mining Company Limited filed a Form 6-K to report a fatal seismicity-related incident at its Moab Khotsong mine on September 6, 2026. The filing conveys condolences, notes stakeholder notification, and states that an investigation led by the Department of Mineral and Petroleum Resources is underway. No financial terms, strategic transactions, or special-situation events are disclosed. This is an operational and safety disclosure, not a special-situation category. Routine reporting of an incident does not trigger any M&A, restructuring, or activist classification. The event may affect production but is not a corporate action warranting special-situation designation.
